author: krisoshea.eth
content:
Hey everyone, hope you're all well. Dropping my Week 14 update here.

The main milestone this week was getting the Engine PayloadSource PR merged after another review pass from Nico. We simplified it quite a bit, the Builder now always passes null for custody columns, since it doesn't custody or sample data columns, and I cut back some of the more generic typing and checks. I merged those changes through the downstream orchestration, bid and reveal branches, adapted them to the simplified payload types and took the orchestrator, bid assembly and envelope assembly PRs out of draft, so all six are now up for review. Marko has given bid assembly an LGTM, and Nazar left a review on envelope assembly pr which I'll pick up this week.

I also opened a Lodestar draft implementing the post-Gloas payload_attributes changes from Beacon APIs #638, so a sidecar Builder gets the safe and finalized execution hashes it needs to reproduce the beacon node's forkchoice state when it calls engine_forkchoiceUpdated.

author: krisoshea.eth
content:
A lot of the other work was around the Beacon API surface. #641, which proposes adding builder_index and block_hash to the block event, turned into a broader discussion about whether this should be a dedicated bid_included event instead, and whether the BN should expose a separate "reveal now" signal based on attestation support, as eth2353 suggested. I dug through the relevant Gloas fork-choice/payment rules and continued that discussion in the ePBS/payload-builders channel. My current view is that bid inclusion is an objective fact the API can expose, while reveal timing is a separate Builder policy question, and I've opened an issue to evaluate a weight-based signal on its own. Nico reviewed the PR on Monday, thinks extending the block event is the simplest option, and asked me to trim the description right down, so that's next.

I also reviewed Marko's Gloas envelope archive de-duplication PR and flagged a few storage/serving details.

The unknown-block sync fix from last week also merged. Next up is answering the reviews on the remaining bid → selection → reveal pieces while pushing the runtime wiring towards a real BN/EL end-to-end run. Cheers!
